newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea reaffirms support to Kia's subcontractors.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea reaffirms support to Kia's subcontractors.

text.p: South Korea's finance ministry said on Tuesday it would urge financial institutions to discount promissory notes issued by the Kia Group companies to their subcontractors.

The ministry said in a statement following a meeting of government officials to discuss Kia that it would raise the ceiling of loan guarantees for the group's primary suppliers. The limit is currently set at 200 million won.

The ministry also said Korea First Bank, Kia's main creditor, would inform Russia that Kia would be able to meet a previous commitment to supply knock-down kits and assembly technology to a Russian car assembler in Kaliningrad.
